messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — retention proposal for discussion: move to tiered retention for infra-prod logs: hot=90d (fast query), warm=180d (limited queries), cold=365d (archival). Goal: reduce bulk SIEM exports of cold data and lower KMS unwrap events.
priya: How will this affect downstream consumers that expect 1yr data? Any migration/notification window?
dan: We'll provide a 90-day window before enforcement, and a one-time bulk export path for archived data (approved by legal). Exports from cold tier will require extra approvals + keywrap grants.
taylor: For KMS, recommendation is per-environment CMKs + ephemeral unwrap grants that expire after 24h. No long-lived export keys. Grants should be auditable and tied to ticket IDs.
priya: RBAC change request: split export perms into 'export_initiator' (can create export job) and 'export_authorizer' (can approve unwrap). Enforce separation-of-duty: no user in both roles for the same tenant.
sam: Also propose an emergency forensics path: 3-person oncall attestation (secops + infra + eng lead) that creates an elevated one-hour grant and emits a high-severity alert. Post-hoc audit required within 48h.
secops-bot: note: proposed enforcement will add structured audit events. Example unwrap audit event we plan to emit:
```json
{
  "event_type": "export_unwrap",
  "cmk_id": "cmk-us-west-2-tenant-42",
  "grant_id": "g-abc123",
  "ticket": "INC-4242",
  "requester": "dan",
  "authorizers": ["taylor","priya"],
  "mode": "full|redacted",
  "reason": "forensic triage - suspected data exfiltration",
  "ts": "2026-05-01T14:12:00Z"
}
```
priya: Can we default partner exports to redacted mode and require a signed DPA + legal signoff for full unwrap? That should reduce live key unwrapping.
dan: Agreed. We'll add a partner flag that forces redaction unless 'legal_approved' is set. The UI will surface DPA checklist.
taylor: Ops will schedule a staged rollout: notify consumers first, then 60d opt-in for extended retention, then enforcement. We'll run a dry-run export in staging with synthetic data to validate audit and alerts.
sam: @legal-team please confirm the legal-hold procedure for archived exports and the requirements for signed forms + retention exceptions.
legal-team: We'll review the legal-hold flow. Main ask: clarifying custodial responsibilities and evidence chain for subpoena/ediscovery. Expect comments by EOD Friday.
mgmt-bot: deploy scheduled: retention-tiering-rollout -> infra-prod on 2026-04-20T04:00Z (migration mode: staged)
priya: I'll draft RBAC change PR and an export job schema for review. Sample export request payload I'll include in PR.
sam: Thanks — plan looks solid. Let's aim for dry-run next week and final enforcement 30 days after legal + consumer notice.
